items.html: Afterward, the mochin of the Panim came to ZON; and then the name HVYH came to the Keter of ZA, of the Panim, in the aspect of four letters alone; and this same HVYH came to the Panim of the Keter of the Nukva, except that it is in the aspect of number, which is the Gematria of 26. And likewise in all the other ten Sefirot, as appears from elsewhere.
